verdict.rationale: Crossplane is fundamentally API-native: it extends the Kubernetes API with CRDs (Providers, Compositions, Managed Resources) and explicitly markets itself as exposing 'declarative APIs that humans, automation, and AI systems can safely act on.' There is no separate UI layer described in the evidence — all configuration, provisioning, and management happens through the Kubernetes API/CLI, meaning there's no UI-only functionality gap by design.
